        </Appearance>
        <Cylinder height='3.5' radius='0.08'/>

      <!-- Animated Flag Group -->
      <Transform DEF='FlagTransform' translation='0 1.1 0'>

            <Coordinate point='0 0.4 0, 1.8 0.25 0, 1.8 -0.45 0, 0 -0.3 0'/>
          </IndexedFaceSet>
        </Shape>
      </Transform>
    </Transform>

    <!-- Gatehouse Structure -->
    <Transform translation='0 4.2 9.5'>
      <!-- Main Gatehouse Block -->
      <Shape>
        <Appearance USE='TowerStoneApp'/>
        <Box size='6 8.4 3.2'/>
      </Shape>
      <!-- Gatehouse Crenellations -->
      <Transform translation='-2.2 4.6 0'><Shape USE='MerlonX'/></Transform>
      <Transform translation='0 4.6 0'><Shape USE='MerlonX'/></Transform>
      <Transform translation='2.2 4.6 0'><Shape USE='MerlonX'/></Transform>
      <!-- Portal Arch Surround (Stone Frame) -->
      <Transform translation='0 -1.6 1.62'>
        <Shape>
          <Appearance>
            <Material diffuseColor='0.35 0.34 0.32' shininess='0.1'/>
          </Appearance>
          <Box size='3.4 5.2 0.3'/>
        </Shape>
      </Transform>
      <!-- Deep Dark Doorway Interior -->
      <Transform translation='0 -1.8 1.7'>
        <Shape>
          <Appearance>
            <Material diffuseColor='0.05 0.05 0.05' shininess='0.0'/>
          </Appearance>
          <Box size='2.5 4.5 0.2'/>
        </Shape>

      <!-- Heavy Portcullis Grate -->

        <Shape>
          <Appearance>
            <Material diffuseColor='0.15 0.15 0.15' emissiveColor='0.2 0.2 0.2'/>
          </Appearance>
          <IndexedLineSet coordIndex='0 1 -1 2 3 -1 4 5 -1 6 7 -1 8 9 -1 10 11 -1'>
            <Coordinate point='-1 -2.25 0, -1 2.25 0, -0.5 -2.25 0, -0.5 2.25 0, 0 -2.25 0, 0 2.25 0, 0.5 -2.25 0, 0.5 2.25 0, 1 -2.25 0, 1 2.25 0, -1.2 0 0, 1.2 0 0'/>
          </IndexedLineSet>
        </Shape>
      </Transform>

    <!-- Left and Right Gate Turrets -->
    <Transform translation='-3.2 4.5 10.5'>
      <Shape>
        <Appearance USE='TowerStoneApp'/>
        <Cylinder height='9' radius='1.1'/>
      </Shape>
      <Transform translation='0 5.2 0'>
        <Shape>
          <Appearance USE='RoofApp'/>
          <Cone bottomRadius='1.4' height='2'/>
        </Shape>
      </Transform>
    </Transform>
    <Transform translation='3.2 4.5 10.5'>
      <Shape>
        <Appearance USE='TowerStoneApp'/>
        <Cylinder height='9' radius='1.1'/>
      </Shape>
      <Transform translation='0 5.2 0'>
        <Shape>
          <Appearance USE='RoofApp'/>
          <Cone bottomRadius='1.4' height='2'/>
        </Shape>
      </Transform>
    </Transform>

    <!-- Wooden Drawbridge in front of Gate -->
    <Transform translation='0 0.15 13.5' rotation='1 0 0 0.05'>
      <Shape>
        <Appearance>
          <Material diffuseColor='0.38 0.24 0.12' shininess='0.1'/>
        </Appearance>
        <Box size='2.6 0.25 5'/>
      </Shape>
    </Transform>

    <TimeSensor DEF='FlagTimer' cycleInterval='2.0' loop='true'/>
    <OrientationInterpolator DEF='FlagFlutter' key='0.0 0.25 0.5 0.75 1.0' keyValue='0 1 0 0.08, 0 1 0 -0.15, 0 1 0 0.12, 0 1 0 -0.06, 0 1 0 0.08'/>
    <ROUTE fromNode='FlagTimer' fromField='fraction_changed' toNode='FlagFlutter' toField='set_fraction'/>
    <ROUTE fromNode='FlagFlutter' fromField='value_changed' toNode='FlagTransform' toField='set_rotation'/>
  </Scene>
</X3D>

items.pt: A Greek temple: a three-step stone base, eight cylindrical columns along each long side built with DEF and USE, a flat roof slab and a triangular pediment, in warm marble tones, lit by a low sun (DirectionalLight) on green ground.
items.body:
<X3D profile='Immersive' version='4.0' xmlns:xsd='http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance' xsd:noNamespaceSchemaLocation='https://www.web3d.org/specifications/x3d-4.0.xsd'>
  <head>
    <meta name='title' content='Greek Temple'/>
    <meta name='description' content='A classical Greek peristyle temple with 8 columns along each long side, a three-step crepidoma, entablature, pediments, and warm marble tones under low sunlight.'/>
  </head>
  <Scene>
    <WorldInfo title='Greek Temple'/>

    <Background
      skyAngle='1.2 1.57'
      skyColor='0.22 0.38 0.68, 0.58 0.68 0.82, 0.96 0.84 0.66'
      groundAngle='1.57'
      groundColor='0.18 0.28 0.15, 0.28 0.45 0.20'/>

    <DirectionalLight
      direction='-0.78 -0.32 -0.54'
      color='1.0 0.86 0.64'
      intensity='1.3'
      shadows='true'/>
    <DirectionalLight
      direction='0.6 0.8 0.5'
      color='0.4 0.52 0.68'
      intensity='0.45'/>

    <Viewpoint
      description='Three-Quarter View'
      position='26 9 30'
      orientation='-0.18 0.97 0.16 0.72'/>
    <Viewpoint
      description='Front Facade'
      position='0 5 26'/>
    <Viewpoint
      description='Colonnade Detail'
      position='-7.5 3.5 16'
      orientation='0 1 0 -0.4'/>

    <!-- Green Ground -->
    <Transform translation='0 -0.05 0'>
      <Shape>
        <Appearance>
          <Material DEF='GrassMat' diffuseColor='0.28 0.46 0.20' specularColor='0.05 0.05 0.05' shininess='0.05'/>
        </Appearance>
        <Box size='120 0.1 120'/>
      </Shape>
    </Transform>

    <!-- Three-Step Stone Base (Crepidoma) -->
    <Transform translation='0 0.2 0'>
      <Shape>
        <Appearance>
          <Material DEF='MarbleBaseMat' diffuseColor='0.90 0.86 0.78' specularColor='0.2 0.18 0.15' shininess='0.2' ambientIntensity='0.25'/>
        </Appearance>
        <Box size='16.0 0.4 31.0'/>
      </Shape>
    </Transform>
    <Transform translation='0 0.6 0'>
      <Shape>
        <Appearance>
          <Material USE='MarbleBaseMat'/>
        </Appearance>
        <Box size='15.0 0.4 30.0'/>
      </Shape>
    </Transform>
    <Transform translation='0 1.0 0'>
      <Shape>
        <Appearance>
          <Material DEF='MarbleMat' diffuseColor='0.95 0.91 0.83' specularColor='0.28 0.25 0.20' shininess='0.25' ambientIntensity='0.3'/>
        </Appearance>
        <Box size='14.0 0.4 29.0'/>
      </Shape>
    </Transform>

    <!-- Inner Chamber (Cella / Naos) -->
    <Transform translation='0 4.2 0'>
      <Shape>
        <Appearance>
          <Material DEF='InnerStoneMat' diffuseColor='0.84 0.79 0.70' specularColor='0.15 0.14 0.12' shininess='0.1'/>
        </Appearance>
        <Box size='7.4 6.0 20.0'/>
      </Shape>
    </Transform>
    <!-- Temple Portal / Door -->
    <Transform translation='0 3.3 10.05'>
      <Shape>
        <Appearance>
          <Material diffuseColor='0.20 0.16 0.12' specularColor='0.4 0.35 0.2' shininess='0.4'/>
        </Appearance>
        <Box size='2.4 4.2 0.2'/>
      </Shape>
    </Transform>

    <!-- Column Prototype DEF -->
    <Transform DEF='Column' translation='-5.8 0 12.6'>
      <!-- Plinth -->
      <Transform translation='0 1.3 0'>
        <Shape>
          <Appearance><Material USE='MarbleMat'/></Appearance>
          <Box size='1.4 0.2 1.4'/>
        </Shape>
      </Transform>
      <!-- Shaft -->
      <Transform translation='0 4.3 0'>
        <Shape>
          <Appearance><Material USE='MarbleMat'/></Appearance>
          <Cylinder height='5.8' radius='0.52'/>
        </Shape>
      </Transform>
      <!-- Capital (Echinus & Abacus) -->
      <Transform translation='0 7.25 0'>
        <Shape>
          <Appearance><Material USE='MarbleMat'/></Appearance>
          <Cylinder height='0.2' radius='0.68'/>
        </Shape>
      </Transform>
      <Transform translation='0 7.42 0'>
        <Shape>
          <Appearance><Material USE='MarbleMat'/></Appearance>
          <Box size='1.4 0.16 1.4'/>
        </Shape>
      </Transform>
    </Transform>

    <!-- Left Long Side (8 columns total along Z: 12.6 to -12.6) -->
    <!-- Column 1 is the DEF above at (-5.8, 0, 12.6) -->
    <Transform translation='-5.8 0 9.0'><Transform USE='Column'/></Transform>
    <Transform translation='-5.8 0 5.4'><Transform USE='Column'/></Transform>
    <Transform translation='-5.8 0 1.8'><Transform USE='Column'/></Transform>
    <Transform translation='-5.8 0 -1.8'><Transform USE='Column'/></Transform>
    <Transform translation='-5.8 0 -5.4'><Transform USE='Column'/></Transform>
    <Transform translation='-5.8 0 -9.0'><Transform USE='Column'/></Transform>
    <Transform translation='-5.8 0 -12.6'><Transform USE='Column'/></Transform>

    <!-- Right Long Side (8 columns along Z: 12.6 to -12.6) -->
    <Transform translation='5.8 0 12.6'><Transform USE='Column'/></Transform>
    <Transform translation='5.8 0 9.0'><Transform USE='Column'/></Transform>
    <Transform translation='5.8 0 5.4'><Transform USE='Column'/></Transform>
    <Transform translation='5.8 0 1.8'><Transform USE='Column'/></Transform>
    <Transform translation='5.8 0 -1.8'><Transform USE='Column'/></Transform>
    <Transform translation='5.8 0 -5.4'><Transform USE='Column'/></Transform>
    <Transform translation='5.8 0 -9.0'><Transform USE='Column'/></Transform>
    <Transform translation='5.8 0 -12.6'><Transform USE='Column'/></Transform>

    <!-- Intermediate Facade Columns (Front: Z = 12.6) -->
    <Transform translation='-1.93 0 12.6'><Transform USE='Column'/></Transform>
    <Transform translation='1.93 0 12.6'><Transform USE='Column'/></Transform>

    <!-- Intermediate Rear Columns (Back: Z = -12.6) -->
    <Transform translation='-1.93 0 -12.6'><Transform USE='Column'/></Transform>
    <Transform translation='1.93 0 -12.6'><Transform USE='Column'/></Transform>

    <!-- Entablature: Epistyle and Frieze -->
    <Transform translation='0 7.9 0'>
      <Shape>
        <Appearance>
          <Material USE='MarbleMat'/>
        </Appearance>
        <Box size='13.4 0.8 28.4'/>
      </Shape>
    </Transform>

    <!-- Flat Roof Slab / Projecting Cornice (Geison) -->
    <Transform translation='0 8.45 0'>
      <Shape>
        <Appearance>
          <Material USE='MarbleMat'/>
        </Appearance>
        <Box size='14.2 0.3 29.2'/>
      </Shape>
    </Transform>

    <!-- Front Pediment (Tympanum) -->
    <Transform translation='0 0 14.5'>
      <Shape>
        <Appearance>
          <Material USE='MarbleMat'/>
        </Appearance>
        <IndexedFaceSet coordIndex='0 1 2 -1' solid='false'>
          <Coordinate point='-7.0 8.6 0, 7.0 8.6 0, 0 11.4 0'/>
        </IndexedFaceSet>
      </Shape>
    </Transform>

    <!-- Back Pediment (Tympanum) -->
    <Transform translation='0 0 -14.5'>
      <Shape>
        <Appearance>
          <Material USE='MarbleMat'/>
        </Appearance>
        <IndexedFaceSet coordIndex='0 1 2 -1' solid='false'>
          <Coordinate point='7.0 8.6 0, -7.0 8.6 0, 0 11.4 0'/>
        </IndexedFaceSet>
      </Shape>
    </Transform>

    <!-- Pitched Roof Slopes -->
    <!-- Right Slope -->
    <Transform translation='3.55 10.0 0' rotation='0 0 1 -0.3805'>
      <Shape>
        <Appearance>
          <Material DEF='RoofMat' diffuseColor='0.88 0.72 0.58' specularColor='0.15 0.12 0.1' shininess='0.15'/>
        </Appearance>
        <Box size='7.7 0.16 29.4'/>
      </Shape>
    </Transform>
    <!-- Left Slope -->
    <Transform translation='-3.55 10.0 0' rotation='0 0 1 0.3805'>
      <Shape>
        <Appearance>
          <Material USE='RoofMat'/>
        </Appearance>
        <Box size='7.7 0.16 29.4'/>
      </Shape>
    </Transform>

    <!-- Ridge Beam -->
    <Transform translation='0 11.45 0'>
      <Shape>
        <Appearance>
          <Material USE='MarbleMat'/>
        </Appearance>
        <Box size='0.5 0.2 29.6'/>
      </Shape>
    </Transform>
  </Scene>
</X3D>

    <meta content='X3D-Edit 4.0' name='generator'/>
  </head>
  <Scene>
    <WorldInfo title='Ferris Wheel at Sunset'/>
    <Background groundAngle='1.5708' groundColor='0.12 0.09 0.07 0.08 0.06 0.06' skyAngle='1.15 1.42 1.5708' skyColor='0.12 0.1 0.25 0.38 0.18 0.32 0.78 0.38 0.18 0.95 0.65 0.28'/>
    <Viewpoint description='Front View' position='0 10 24'/>
    <Viewpoint description='Side View' orientation='0 1 0 1.5708' position='24 10 0'/>

    <!-- Ground Platform -->

          <Material diffuseColor='0.18 0.16 0.14'/>

      <Shape>
        <Appearance>
          <Material diffuseColor='0.35 0.22 0.15'/>

        </Appearance>
        <Box size='6 1 0.08'/>
      </Shape>
    </Transform>

    <!-- Rotating Wheel Assembly -->
    <Transform DEF='Wheel' translation='0 10 0'>
      <!-- Hub -->
      <Transform rotation='1 0 0 1.5708'>
        <Shape>
          <Appearance DEF='WheelWhite'>
            <Material diffuseColor='0.92 0.92 0.95' shininess='0.4' specularColor='0.3 0.3 0.3'/>
          </Appearance>
          <Cylinder height='1.6' radius='0.7'/>
        </Shape>

items.pt: A desk lamp with an articulated arm: a round base, a lower arm, an upper arm and a cone shade with a SpotLight inside pointing down at a small wooden desk surface; the upper arm sways slowly back and forth.
items.body:
<X3D profile='Immersive' version='4.0' xmlns:xsd='http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance' xsd:noNamespaceSchemaLocation='https://www.web3d.org/specifications/x3d-4.0.xsd'>
  <head>
    <component name='Shape' level='2'/>
    <meta name='title' content='Articulated Desk Lamp'/>
    <meta name='description' content='A metal desk lamp with a slowly swaying upper arm and a downward-facing spotlight. Touch the base to restart the motion.'/>
  </head>
  <Scene>
    <WorldInfo title='Articulated Desk Lamp'/>
    <Background skyColor='0.045 0.065 0.095'/>
    <NavigationInfo type='"EXAMINE" "ANY"' headlight='false'/>
    <Viewpoint description='Desk lamp — three-quarter view' position='3.1 2.7 4.6' orientation='-0.375 0.915 0.147 0.637' centerOfRotation='0 1.05 0'/>
    <DirectionalLight direction='-0.5 -1 -0.4' color='0.83 0.9 1' intensity='0.75' ambientIntensity='0.2'/>
    <PointLight location='-2 3 2' color='1 0.87 0.7' intensity='0.45' radius='8'/>

    <!-- Ground and compact wooden desk. -->
    <Transform translation='0 -0.035 0'>
      <Shape>
        <Appearance>
          <Material diffuseColor='0.11 0.14 0.18' specularColor='0.08 0.08 0.08' shininess='0.1'/>
        </Appearance>
        <Box size='12 0.06 12'/>
      </Shape>
    </Transform>

    <Transform translation='0 0.78 0'>
      <Shape>
        <Appearance DEF='Wood'>
          <Material diffuseColor='0.48 0.255 0.105' specularColor='0.22 0.15 0.08' shininess='0.22'/>
        </Appearance>
        <Box size='2.1 0.12 1.25'/>
      </Shape>
    </Transform>
    <Transform translation='0 0.843 -0.43'>
      <Shape>
        <Appearance DEF='WoodGrain'>
          <Material diffuseColor='0.34 0.16 0.065'/>
        </Appearance>
        <Box size='2.04 0.002 0.008'/>
      </Shape>
    </Transform>
    <Transform translation='0 0.843 -0.19'>
      <Shape>
        <Appearance USE='WoodGrain'/>
        <Box size='2.04 0.002 0.005'/>
      </Shape>
    </Transform>
    <Transform translation='0 0.843 0.12'>
      <Shape>
        <Appearance USE='WoodGrain'/>
        <Box size='2.04 0.002 0.007'/>
      </Shape>
    </Transform>
    <Transform translation='0 0.843 0.39'>
      <Shape>
        <Appearance USE='WoodGrain'/>
        <Box size='2.04 0.002 0.004'/>
      </Shape>
    </Transform>
    <Transform translation='-0.88 0.365 -0.46'>
      <Shape>
        <Appearance USE='Wood'/>
        <Box size='0.09 0.73 0.09'/>
      </Shape>
    </Transform>
    <Transform translation='0.88 0.365 -0.46'>
      <Shape>
        <Appearance USE='Wood'/>
        <Box size='0.09 0.73 0.09'/>

    </Transform>
    <Transform translation='-0.88 0.365 0.46'>
      <Shape>
        <Appearance USE='Wood'/>
        <Box size='0.09 0.73 0.09'/>
      </Shape>
    </Transform>
    <Transform translation='0.88 0.365 0.46'>
      <Shape>
        <Appearance USE='Wood'/>
        <Box size='0.09 0.73 0.09'/>
      </Shape>
    </Transform>

    <!-- Round weighted base; touching it restarts the sway. -->
    <Transform translation='-0.55 0.882 0'>
      <TouchSensor DEF='BaseTouch' description='Restart the upper-arm sway'/>
      <Shape>
        <Appearance DEF='DarkMetal'>
          <PhysicalMaterial baseColor='0.045 0.085 0.105' metallic='0.75' roughness='0.27'/>
        </Appearance>
        <Cylinder radius='0.25' height='0.075'/>
      </Shape>
      <Transform translation='0 -0.028 0'>
        <Shape>
          <Appearance DEF='Rubber'>
            <Material diffuseColor='0.025 0.028 0.032'/>
          </Appearance>
          <Cylinder radius='0.258' height='0.018'/>
        </Shape>
      </Transform>
      <Transform translation='0 0.046 0'>
        <Shape>
          <Appearance USE='DarkMetal'/>
          <Cylinder radius='0.15' height='0.022'/>
        </Shape>
      </Transform>
      <Transform translation='0.13 0.047 0.09'>
        <Shape>
          <Appearance USE='Rubber'/>
          <Cylinder radius='0.025' height='0.02'/>
        </Shape>
      </Transform>
    </Transform>

    <!-- Lower articulated arm, angled toward the desk center. -->
    <Transform translation='-0.55 0.95 0' rotation='0 0 1 -0.4'>
      <Transform rotation='1 0 0 1.570796'>
        <Shape>
          <Appearance USE='DarkMetal'/>
          <Cylinder radius='0.064' height='0.13'/>
        </Shape>
        <Transform translation='0 0.074 0'>
          <Shape>
            <Appearance DEF='Brass'>
              <PhysicalMaterial baseColor='0.68 0.44 0.17' metallic='0.85' roughness='0.25'/>
            </Appearance>
            <Cylinder radius='0.032' height='0.025'/>
          </Shape>
        </Transform>
      </Transform>
      <Transform translation='0 0.32 0'>
        <Shape>
          <Appearance USE='DarkMetal'/>
          <Box size='0.065 0.64 0.075'/>
        </Shape>
      </Transform>
      <Transform translation='0 0.32 0.042'>
        <Shape>
          <Appearance USE='Brass'/>
          <Box size='0.018 0.49 0.008'/>
        </Shape>
      </Transform>

      <!-- This joint and all of its descendants sway together. -->
      <Transform translation='0 0.64 0'>
        <Transform rotation='1 0 0 1.570796'>
          <Shape>
            <Appearance USE='DarkMetal'/>
            <Cylinder radius='0.075' height='0.15'/>
          </Shape>
          <Transform translation='0 0.087 0'>
            <Shape>
              <Appearance USE='Brass'/>
              <Cylinder radius='0.039' height='0.028'/>

        <Transform DEF='UpperArm' rotation='0 0 1 -0.55'>

            <Shape>
              <Appearance USE='DarkMetal'/>
              <Box size='0.055 0.56 0.065'/>
            </Shape>
          </Transform>
          <Transform translation='0 0.28 0.037'>
            <Shape>
              <Appearance USE='Brass'/>
              <Box size='0.014 0.43 0.008'/>
            </Shape>
          </Transform>

          <!-- Counter-angled shade hangs downward at the middle of the sway. -->
          <Transform translation='0 0.56 0' rotation='0 0 1 0.95'>
            <Transform rotation='1 0 0 1.570796'>
              <Shape>
                <Appearance USE='Brass'/>
                <Cylinder radius='0.045' height='0.1'/>
              </Shape>
            </Transform>
            <Transform translation='0 -0.055 0'>
              <Shape>
                <Appearance USE='DarkMetal'/>
                <Cylinder radius='0.035' height='0.11'/>
              </Shape>
            </Transform>
            <Transform translation='0 -0.21 0'>
              <Shape>
                <Appearance USE='DarkMetal'/>
                <Cone bottomRadius='0.235' height='0.32' bottom='false' solid='false'/>
              </Shape>
              <Transform translation='0 -0.004 0' scale='0.95 0.95 0.95'>
                <Shape>
                  <Appearance>
                    <Material diffuseColor='0.87 0.8 0.6' emissiveColor='0.14 0.1 0.045' specularColor='0.3 0.27 0.19' shininess='0.3'/>
                  </Appearance>
                  <Cone bottomRadius='0.235' height='0.32' bottom='false' solid='false'/>
                </Shape>
              </Transform>
              <Transform translation='0 -0.075 0'>
                <Shape>
                  <Appearance>
                    <Material diffuseColor='1 0.9 0.63' emissiveColor='1 0.78 0.38'/>
                  </Appearance>
                  <Sphere radius='0.052'/>
                </Shape>
              </Transform>
              <SpotLight location='0 -0.13 0' direction='0 -1 0' color='1 0.84 0.58' intensity='2.4' beamWidth='0.45' cutOffAngle='0.82' radius='4' attenuation='1 0.15 0.08' global='true'/>
            </Transform>
          </Transform>
        </Transform>
      </Transform>
    </Transform>

    <TimeSensor DEF='SwayClock' cycleInterval='12' loop='true'/>
    <OrientationInterpolator DEF='SwayRotation' key='0 0.25 0.5 0.75 1' keyValue='0 0 1 -0.55, 0 0 1 -0.70, 0 0 1 -0.55, 0 0 1 -0.40, 0 0 1 -0.55'/>
    <ROUTE fromNode='SwayClock' fromField='fraction_changed' toNode='SwayRotation' toField='set_fraction'/>
    <ROUTE fromNode='SwayRotation' fromField='value_changed' toNode='UpperArm' toField='set_rotation'/>
    <ROUTE fromNode='BaseTouch' fromField='touchTime' toNode='SwayClock' toField='set_startTime'/>
  </Scene>
</X3D>
